reader.requirement: At --std 85 a format 1 GO TO (GO TO procedure-name-1, and the target-less GO TO, which SR3 holds to the stricter single-statement-paragraph rule) written in a consecutive sequence of imperative statements of a sentence (or of an imperative-statement/statement-1/statement-2 phrase) must be the last of that sequence: a following imperative statement (including a delimited-scope statement, which is imperative by §1985:IV.6.4.2.3.1) is refused, while a following conditional statement (IF, EVALUATE, SEARCH, RETURN, or a statement with an unterminated conditional phrase, §1985:IV.6.4.2.1.1) ends the run and is legal. Format 2 is not governed.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable(bare-goto-removed-2002) asks the target-less GO TO's SR3 row only where that statement exists (85); the GoToLast row for GO TO procedure-name-1 carries no construct and is asked at every edition

reader.edition-search: Grepped StatementPosition.cs, ConditionalStatements.cs and GoToFormat.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior; the only read is the construct gate on the BareGoToAlone row. IsConditional reads the parse (a statementBlock phrase without the END- terminator), not an edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the target-less format 1 GO TO, which exists at 85 alone and is held to SR3 (whole paragraph) instead; GO TO procedure-name-1 is screened identically at 85 and 2023 (gl_bad gives the same five COBOL2967 at --std 2023)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the three witnesses cover a GO TO before a conditional statement, out of an inline PERFORM and legal sequence placement; not exercised there: IF/SEARCH with NEXT SENTENCE as the following conditional, a following delimited-scope (END-ADD, END-IF) statement refused, GO TO inside statement-1 followed by an imperative, and the target-less GO TO

probes.printed: five COBOL2967 (followed by DISPLAY; inside IF statement-1 followed by DISPLAY; followed by ADD ... END-ADD; followed by IF ... END-IF; inside statement-1 followed by MOVE)
probes.expected: each refused: the following statement is imperative (a delimited scope statement is imperative)
GO TO followed by unterminated IF, ADD ON SIZE ERROR, EVALUATE is legal; GO TO last in IF statement-1 legal; format 2 followed by DISPLAY not governed (WS-N=1 goes to P6)
GO TO followed by IF ... NEXT SENTENCE [ELSE NEXT SENTENCE] (a conditional statement at 85) is legal
GO TO followed by SEARCH ... WHEN ... NEXT SENTENCE (conditional) is legal

probes.printed: COBOL6818 at 12,12: the target-less GO TO shares its sentence with 1 other statement; the lone 'SW. GO TO.' paragraph accepted
probes.expected: the 85-only target-less format 1 GO TO followed by DISPLAY refused (SR3 subsumes SR4)

reader.notes: The funnel asks PlacementRules.RefusedOutOfSequence of every statement; the GoToLast row refuses a format 1 GO TO whose next sibling in its sentence or statement block is not conditional, with conditionality read off the parse (an unterminated conditional phrase). The 1985 conditional-statement list (IF, EVALUATE, SEARCH, RETURN and phrase-bearing I-O, arithmetic, STRING/UNSTRING, CALL) matches that reading, including IF with NEXT SENTENCE.

END-PERFORM followed by DISPLAY; followed by SEARCH ... END-SEARCH and by READ ... AT END ... END-IF DISPLAY (GO TO last of statement-1), GO TO before ELSE, GO TO before NOT ON SIZE ERROR (a phrase, not a statement) taken at size error, GO TO before WHEN OTHER, GO TO followed by an unterminated READ AT END (conditional): all admitted. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.15.3 SR4 'it must appear as the last statement in that sequence'; OK §1985:IV.6.4.2.3.1 'a conditional statement that is delimited by its explicit scope terminator'.
